title: The Subscriptions for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 2.1.1 only enforces its membership content restrictions on…
description: The Subscriptions for WooCommerce WordPress plugin versions before 2.1.1 have a vulnerability where membership content restrictions are only enforced on standard front-end page views. This allows unauthenticated users to access the full contents of restricted posts and pages through alternative routes that render the same content.
